description: This Python source file defines classes PatternUtils and PatternMatchRouter, which handle regex pattern matching and routing for Large Language Model (LLM) deployment configurations based on pattern matching with wildcards and regex. It includes methods for adding patterns, converting wildcards to regex, routing requests to matching patterns, and setting deployment model names based on matched patterns.

classes.name: PatternUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to compute pattern specificity and sort patterns by their specificity.

classes.name: PatternMatchRouter
classes.description: A class handling wildcard pattern routing for LLM deployment configurations, including methods to add patterns, convert patterns to regex, route requests, and manipulate deployment model names based on pattern matches.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] calculate_pattern_specificity(pattern: str)
methods.description: Calculates the specificity of a regex pattern based on its length and regex complexity.

methods.name: List[Tuple[str,List[Dict]]] sorted_patterns( patterns: Dict[str, List[Dict]] )
methods.description: Returns the patterns sorted by their specificity in descending order.

methods.name: add_pattern(self, pattern: str, llm_deployment: Dict)
methods.description: Adds a regex pattern and associated deployment information to the patterns dictionary.

methods.name: str _pattern_to_regex(self, pattern: str)
methods.description: Converts a wildcard pattern into a regex pattern by escaping special characters and replacing '*' with '.*'.

methods.name: List[Dict] _return_pattern_matched_deployments( self, matched_pattern: Match, deployments: List[Dict] )
methods.description: Produces a list of deployments with their 'model' parameter updated based on the pattern match.

methods.name: Optional[List[Dict]] route( self, request: Optional[str], filtered_model_names: Optional[List[str]] = None )
methods.description: Routes a model request string to the matching pattern's deployments, if any.

methods.name: str set_deployment_model_name( matched_pattern: Match, litellm_deployment_litellm_model: str, )
methods.description: Replaces wildcards in deployment model name with actual matched segments.

methods.name: Optional[List[Dict]] get_pattern( self, model: str, custom_llm_provider: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Identifies if a pattern exists for a given model and role provider.

methods.name: List[Dict] get_deployments_by_pattern( self, model: str, custom_llm_provider: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Retrieves deployment configurations matching patterns for a given model.
